label: NOTE: v27rx_create and v29tx_create behavior versus the exact opposite-width clear schedule
why: t_faxadapt compares default and caller-provided configurations across every rate arm and checks all three count/width fields against the blob. The final two mutations record the former statement orders as equivalent: the assignments address distinct fields of one live faxvmi_link, and neither right-hand side reads the field cleared by the other assignment. Their ordering is object-code evidence, not a behavioral distinction.
